name: Senani Thunderheart
summary: At Splintertree Post in Ashenvale, Senani Thunderheart puts hunters to the test. She serves the Horde by sending travelers after the forest’s fiercest predators, a trial of skill that also thins the beasts near Horde territory.

sections.title: The Master of the Hunt
sections.body: At Splintertree Post, Senani Thunderheart carries on the tauren hunting traditions in Ashenvale. Far from Mulgore’s open plains, she sends Horde hunters against the forest’s great beasts to test their tracking and fighting skill. For Senani, the hunt is an honorable challenge and a way to survive in a wild, contested land.

sections.title: The Beasts of Ashenvale
sections.body: Senani directs hunters toward three feared predators: the bear Ursangous, the cat Shadumbra, and the hippogryph Sharptalon. Their tokens are a paw, a head, and a claw. Claiming them marks a hunter’s passage and shows respect for the land and mastery of its fiercest beasts.

faq.answer: Senani Thunderheart is a tauren huntress at Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. She serves the Horde by sending hunters after the forest’s most dangerous wildlife.

faq.q: Where can I find Senani Thunderheart?
faq.answer: You can find Senani at Splintertree Post, the Horde outpost in Ashenvale directly north of the Barrens.
The Ashenvale Hunt is a series of challenges Senani gives hunters. They track and slay three famed predators: Ursangous the bear, Shadumbra the nightsaber, and Sharptalon the hippogryph.

faq.q: Which trophies does Senani require for the hunt?
faq.answer: Senani asks hunters to bring back Ursangous’s Paw, Shadumbra’s Head, and Sharptalon’s Claw as proof that they bested all three beasts.

faq.q: Does Senani have any connection to the furbolgs in the area?
faq.answer: Senani’s hunts do not concern the furbolgs. Her charge is the Ashenvale Hunt, while the Foulweald and other furbolg tribes are among the forest’s dangers.

faq.q: Is Senani affiliated with the Cenarion Circle?
faq.answer: No. Senani serves the Horde and the tauren tribes, and meets the woods as a traditional hunter rather than as a druidic guardian of the Cenarion Circle.

angles.text: As a tauren traveler, meeting Senani recalls the Earth Mother’s trials and the ancient balance between hunter and quarry, far from Mulgore.
As a hunter, you face Senani’s test of tracking against Ashenvale’s elusive beasts: Ursangous, Shadumbra, and Sharptalon.
As a member of the Horde, you’ll find Splintertree Post is your foothold in Ashenvale, where Senani helps scouts prove their worth and secure the wilderness.
